info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS Elastic Beanstalk API (2010-12-01). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Applications and application versions are stored configuration served over the Query protocol: no environment, configuration template, platform version, instance, load balancer, managed action, event or health record exists, and CreateEnvironment, CreateConfigurationTemplate, CreatePlatformVersion, DescribeEnvironments, DescribeEvents, ListAvailableSolutionStacks and every other official operation return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Nothing is deployed. An application version is created without a source: SourceBundle, SourceBuildInformation, BuildConfiguration, Process=true and AutoCreateApplication=true are refused, because the simulator never reads, builds or validates an S3, CodeCommit or CodeBuild source, and the version is the sample application the official operation documents for a request without a source. Versions report no Status, SourceBundle or BuildArn. DeleteApplicationVersion accepts DeleteSourceBundle because no bundle exists to delete. DescribeApplications reports no Versions or ConfigurationTemplates; read versions with DescribeApplicationVersions, which requires ApplicationName (the official operation also lists every application's versions). An unknown name in ApplicationNames, VersionLabels or a lookup fails with InvalidParameterValue, as UpdateApplication documents, instead of being skipped. Application names and version labels are 1 to 100 characters and must not contain a forward slash, which the ARNs arn:aws:elasticbeanstalk:region:account:application/name and applicationversion/application/label would make ambiguous. DeleteApplication removes its versions, accepts TerminateEnvByForce because no environment exists, and does not delete anything from S3. ResourceLifecycleConfig is stored and returned but never applied: no version is deleted by a MaxCountRule or MaxAgeRule, the service role is checked only for the form arn:aws:iam::account:role/name and is never assumed, and rule members are validated only against the official shape. ServiceRole must accompany every VersionLifecycleConfig, in CreateApplication and in each UpdateApplicationResourceLifecycle call, where the official service persists it after the first one. Tags are accepted at CreateApplication and CreateApplicationVersion and read with ListTagsForResource by the ARN of an application or an application version; the response omits ResourceArn. UpdateTagsForResource is not implemented because one request both adds and removes tags, which the catalog's tag operations cannot express, so tags cannot change after creation. An unknown ARN fails with ResourceNotFoundException. Applications are limited to 75 and versions to 100 per application locally; exceeding them, like more than 50 tags in one request or a name that already exists, fails with InvalidParameterValue because TooManyApplicationsException, TooManyApplicationVersionsException and TooManyTagsException are not selectable for those faults.
